007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Task;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TaskAttributes;
014
015/**
016 * Loads an existing agent task and reads its current metadata and attributes.
017 *
018 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
019 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, and {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_NAME}. The named
020 * task must already exist and be visible to the connected user. See
021 * {@code samples/README.md} for build and run commands.</p>
022 */
023public final class LoadTaskSample {
024
025    private LoadTaskSample() {
026    }
027
028    /**
029     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
030     *
031     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
032     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
033     */
034    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
035        String taskName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_NAME");
036        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
037            Task task = client.task(taskName);
038            System.out.printf("Task: %s%n", task.getTaskName());
039            System.out.printf("Status: %s%n", task.getStatus());
040            System.out.printf("Description: %s%n", task.getDescription());
041            TaskAttributes attributes = task.getTaskAttributes();
042            System.out.printf("Human tool enabled: %s%n", attributes.getEnableHumanTool());
043        }
044    }
045
046    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
047        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
048                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
049                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
050                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
051                .build());
052    }
053
054    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
055        String value = System.getenv(name);
056        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
057            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
058        }
059        return value;
060    }
061}
